name: Portland, ME
subtitle: America's best small food city — lobster to natural wine
items: Eventide Oyster Co. (brown butter lobster roll in a brioche bun — this is the one)
Fore Street (Sam Hayward, wood-fired, since 1996 — the institution)
Hugo's (Andrew Taylor + Mike Wiley, the creative fine dining anchor)
Central Provisions (James Beard nom., small plates, always packed)
Duckfat (Rob Evans, Belgian frites + paninis — the casual masterpiece)
The Honey Paw (Andrew Taylor + Mike Wiley, Asian-influenced, best ramen in New England)
Chaval (Damian Sansonetti + Ilma Lopez, Spanish + French)
Isa Bistro (West End, Catalan, warm neighborhood restaurant)
Cong Tu Bot (Vietnamese, NoPo, Dana Thanh Huynh — noodles, noodles, noodles)
Drifters Wife (natural wine bar — the one that changed Portland's wine culture)
Bao Bao Dumpling House (Portland's best dumplings)
Boone's Fish House & Oyster Room (Old Port, classic Maine seafood)
Holy Donut (potato donuts — dark chocolate sea salt is the move)
Tandem Coffee + Bakery (multiple — the best croissant in Maine)
Palace Diner (Biddeford, tiny counter, perfect diner)
